This notice covers every page of the Pathfinder Toolkit. The rest of the Beholder's Gazette (its news, its 5e Toolkit, and its SRD 5.1 pages) isn't part of it.

Attribution

This product is based on Licensed Material from the Pathfinder Second Edition Remaster books published by Paizo Inc. under the ORC License. Each book's own attribution lines are listed here as the Toolkit starts using material from it.

The Encounter Builder uses creature statistics (level, AC, Hit Points, saves, and Perception) and their stat blocks from Pathfinder Monster Core, Pathfinder Monster Core 2, and Pathfinder NPC Core, the spells those stat blocks cast from Pathfinder Player Core, Pathfinder Player Core 2, and the other books listed here, and the encounter budget and DCs by level from Pathfinder GM Core. The Initiative Tracker uses the conditions and the dying and wounded rules from Pathfinder Player Core, summarized in our own words.
